description: This file defines the JpaNotificationDao class, a Data Access Object implementation for notifications in a SQL database, using Spring Data JPA. It includes methods for querying, updating, and deleting notifications, as well as partition management.

classes.name: JpaNotificationDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing Notification entities in a SQL database, implementing NotificationDao interface with methods for CRUD operations and partition management.

methods.name: findUnreadByDeliveryMethodAndRecipientIdAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds unread notifications by delivery method, recipient ID, and pagination.

methods.name: findUnreadByDeliveryMethodAndRecipientIdAndNotificationTypesAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds unread notifications filtered by delivery method, recipient ID, notification types, and pagination.

methods.name: findByDeliveryMethodAndRecipientIdAndPageLink
methods.description: Finds notifications by delivery method, recipient ID, and pagination.

methods.name: updateStatusByIdAndRecipientId
methods.description: Updates the status of a notification by its ID and recipient ID.

methods.name: countUnreadByDeliveryMethodAndRecipientId
methods.description: Counts unread notifications for a recipient by delivery method.

methods.name: deleteByIdAndRecipientId
methods.description: Deletes a notification by its ID and recipient ID.

methods.name: updateStatusByDeliveryMethodAndRecipientId
methods.description: Updates notification statuses by delivery method and recipient ID.

methods.name: deleteByRequestId
methods.description: Deletes notifications associated with a specific request ID.

methods.name: deleteByRecipientId
methods.description: Deletes all notifications for a specific recipient.

methods.name: createPartition
methods.description: Creates a new database partition for notifications based on creation time.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the entity managed by this DAO.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Returns the JPA repository used for NotificationEntity.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is NOTIFICATION.
